the meaning of Manovana

Mano, the mind. Vana, a forest — a garden. Manovana is the garden of your mind: a place to tend what hurts, and let happiness, love and peace bloom.

Tended by Malavika Hegde — who spent 30 years in IT before moving from Systems to Souls, Logic to Light to become a Mind Coach & Counsellor.

a gentle truth to begin

Mind is everything. What you think, you become.

✿

Mind can make you or break you.

✿

To the mind that is still, the whole universe surrenders.

Malavika Hegde

Mind Coach & Life Coach

meet your coach

From Systems to Souls, Logic to Light.

An IT professional for over 30 years, Malavika Hegde made a transformative shift into mind coaching — tuning into her soul-driven purpose to become a Mind Coach and Counsellor.

“I understand the silent struggles of people who display happiness and success on the outside while carrying loads of pain from the inside.”

Read her story
who is this for

For anyone carrying pain the world can't see.

Anyone aged 18–80 — working professionals, homemakers and retired personnel. Especially those who feel any of this:

  • Doing well outside, broken inside
  • A deep sense of emptiness
  • Stuck in negative thinking
  • Self-sabotaging patterns
  • Mood swings, loneliness & low moods
  • Entangled karmic relationships
  • Baggage therapy hasn't cleared
  • Striving with no inner happiness

You are in safe, experienced, and gentle hands.

Confidential & judgement-free A safe, private space to open up
18,000+ lives touched Across 1-to-1 sessions & groups
30+ years of wisdom From a career in IT to inner healing
A gentle complement Works alongside professional care
